en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a large construction site surrounded by a forest. Several workers are seen amidst earthworks, wooden scaffolding, and inclined ramps, building what appears to be the outlet for a canal. The image is labeled 'Alby. Ringdalens Kanalutlopp under byggnationen.', indicating it shows canal construction. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence and a green Swedish stamp featuring the text 'SVERIGE'. The address is written in Swedish.
